B6T1BqHLqVeGpwE8.description: You gain +1 to attack and damage with a whip. In addition, increase your whip attack range to near. You can also use your whip as a grappling hook, and to trip or disarm creatures no bigger than yourself.
B6T1BqHLqVeGpwE8.name: Whip Mastery

Delver's Skills.description:
You have perfected your crawling trade over the years through study and practice.

Add a bonus equal to half your level (round down) to any of the associated checks:

  • Climbing

  • Finding and disabling traps

  • Deciphering ancient languages

  • Knowledge of history

  • Artifact lore
Delver's Skills.name: Delver's Skills

Explorer.description: Scholars and adventurers by trade, loremasters itching for action, or trailblazing bookworms who exploit their vast knowledge and combine it with delving expertise and a trusty whip.
Explorer.name: Explorer

Improved Delver Skill.description: Gain advantage on one of your delver skills
Improved Delver Skill.name: Improved Delver Skill

Learn Extra Languages.description: Learn two additional common languages or one rare language.
Learn Extra Languages.name: Learn Extra Languages
